prompt: Rewrite this runbook with the engineering-default SEE profile. Put the stop condition before the governed actions, make the action order scannable, and preserve every actor-to-action relation. Do not invent a rollback or success report. Source: To refresh the search replica, first operator Mira runs `orbit snapshot --pool jade`; after the command reports SNAPSHOT_READY, scheduler Keel copies the snapshot to replica N4; only after N4 reports COPY_OK, Mira promotes N4. If any report is absent, stop. Output exactly three lines, each containing one field, in this order: PROFILE: <strict or engineering-default>; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <one line or none>.

source_facts: The purpose is to refresh the search replica.
Operator Mira runs the snapshot command and later promotes replica N4.
Scheduler Keel copies the snapshot to replica N4.
The command must report SNAPSHOT_READY before the copy.
Replica N4 must report COPY_OK before promotion.
Execution stops if either required report is absent.
conditions_and_exceptions: Stop if either report is absent.
required_structure: One-line rewrite with the stop condition before the governed actions.
Snapshot, copy, and promotion remain in source order.
Exactly the declared response fields.
ambiguity_traps: Moving the copy before SNAPSHOT_READY changes the procedure.
Moving promotion before COPY_OK changes the procedure.
Replacing Mira or Keel with an invented generic actor loses typed relations.
permitted_rewrites: Reorder the stop condition before the steps.
Split the dense source into numbered or clearly separated imperative steps.
Change grammar without changing actors, relations, or order.
prohibited_inventions: A rollback action or outcome.
A different operator, scheduler, replica, command, status, or trigger.
An assertion that promotion succeeded.

observable_success: A reader can identify who performs each action and in which order.
The stop condition governs all actions that depend on the two reports.
The command and both report tokens remain available to the operator.
prohibited_outcomes: Copying before SNAPSHOT_READY.
Promoting before COPY_OK.
Assigning the copy to Mira or the promotion to Keel.
Adding rollback instructions or an expected final state.
judge_criteria: Preserve the Mira-runs, Keel-copies, and Mira-promotes relations.
Preserve both temporal gates and make their order easy to follow.
Place the stop condition before the actions it governs.
Do not infer rollback, timing, or successful completion.
